entities.name: AI 编码工具 (AI coding tools)
entities.how_described: 本集说超过一半的工程领导者正在购买 AI coding tools，但代码生成被自动化后痛苦转移到了下游的部署和可靠性

evidence.quote: Well over half of them are buying AI coding tools at the moment.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: So about 52% of the whole audience reports buying AI coding tools.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: And a really interesting difference is when we look at the more senior members of our audience, so VPs, directors, and what we see there is, sure, they're reporting that they are buying AI coding tools, but also we've seen downstream tooling
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: So almost as many of them looking at monster observability as they are AI coding tools, CICD, QA.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: 可观测性 (observability)
entities.how_described: 本集说 VP 和总监层级对 observability 工具的关注度几乎与 AI 编码工具一样高，因为代码生成自动化后可靠性成为下游新痛点

evidence.quote: More interesting is about 20% of them are buying some of the core categories, things like CRCD, monetary and observability.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: So almost as many of them looking at monster observability as they are AI coding tools, CICD, QA.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: CI/CD
entities.how_described: 本集说 CICD 和 QA 测试工具在资深工程领导者中非常受欢迎，是代码生成自动化后瓶颈转移到下游的体现

evidence.quote: So almost as many of them looking at monster observability as they are AI coding tools, CICD, QA.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: 技术债务 (tech debt)
entities.how_described: 本集说速度、可靠性、tech debt 是工程领导者真正关心的前三痛点，AI 实施根本排不进这三项

evidence.quote: The things that they are really caring about are velocity, reliability, tech debt.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: AI 优先 (AI-first)

evidence.quote: Many of the dev tools that we've got as customers have gone strong on AI-first messaging, and that can be quite a dangerous thing to do with our audience.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: And so a large chunk of the buyers are going to start putting barriers up if you're leading with big AI first claims.
